doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this wide navigation rail
doc.state: the [WideNavigationRailState] of this wide navigation rail
doc.hideOnCollapse: whether this wide navigation rail should slide offscreen when it collapses and be hidden, or stay on screen as a collapsed wide navigation rail (default)
doc.collapsedShape: the shape of this wide navigation rail's container when it's collapsed
doc.expandedShape: the shape of this wide navigation rail's container when it's expanded
doc.colors: [WideNavigationRailColors] that will be used to resolve the colors used for this wide navigation rail. See [WideNavigationRailDefaults.colors]
doc.colors.containerColor: the color used for the background of a non-modal wide navigation rail.
doc.colors.contentColor: the preferred color for content inside a wide navigation rail. Defaults to either the matching content color for [containerColor], or to the current [LocalContentColor] if [containerColor] is not a color from the theme
doc.colors.modalContainerColor: the color used for the background of a modal wide navigation rail.
doc.colors.modalScrimColor: the color used for the scrim overlay for background content of a modal wide navigation rail
doc.colors.modalContentColor: the preferred color for content inside a modal wide navigation rail. Defaults to either the matching content color for [modalContainerColor], or to the current [LocalContentColor] if [modalContainerColor] is not a color from the theme
doc.header: optional header that may hold a [FloatingActionButton] or a logo
doc.expandedHeaderTopPadding: the padding to be applied to the top of the rail. It's usually needed in order to align the content of the rail between the collapsed and expanded animation
doc.windowInsets: a window insets of the wide navigation rail
doc.arrangement: the [Arrangement.Vertical] of this wide navigation rail
doc.expandedProperties: [ModalWideNavigationRailProperties] for further customization of the expanded modal wide navigation rail's window behavior
doc.content: the content of this modal wide navigation rail, usually [WideNavigationRailItem]s
